judgment.reason: From p21, at least one of 'Ada wears a cobalt belt' or 'Ada wears a copper coat' is true. If Ada wears a cobalt belt, then by p7 Ada wears an ivory pin. If Ada wears a copper coat, then by p12 Ada wears an ivory pin. In either case (or both), Ada wears an ivory pin. From p3, if Ada wears an ivory pin, then Ada wears a violet badge. Therefore, Ada wears a violet badge follows necessarily from the premises.
